description:
The speed readout on the /fly HUD displays 'NaN km/s' throughout outer-planet missions (Jupiter and beyond).

Expected: The HUD shows a finite numeric speed at all times during outer-planet transfers, never NaN.

Acceptance criteria:
- heliocentricSpeed(rAu, aTransferAu) must never return NaN for any finite positive rAu and aTransferAu [code-invariant: a NaN in a HUD readout is self-evidently a crash-level display bug]
- When (2/rAu - 1/aTransferAu) < 0 (spacecraft beyond apohelion), return local circular orbital speed sqrt(MU_SUN_AU3_YR2 / rAu) * AU_PER_YR_TO_KMS, not NaN [reporter: Reporter: 'beyond apohelion it should return the local circular orbital speed (sqrt(mu / r))']
- When rAu = 0, return 0, not NaN or Infinity [reporter: Reporter: 'at radius = 0 it should return 0']
